abstract: A 23-year-old primigravida with suppurative ovarian dermoid cyst due to Salmonella typhi is presented. The organism could not be isolated from the blood, faeces or urine and it was felt that the patient was an example of non-excretory carrier in whom S. typhi was lying dormant in the ovarian tissue for a long time.
abstract_ja: 23歳の初産婦において、Salmonella typhiによる化膿性卵巣類皮嚢腫の症例を報告する。本菌は血液、便、尿からは分離されず、本患者は非排菌保有者であり、S. typhiが長期間にわたり卵巣組織内に潜伏していたと考えられた。
